ats.title: Before a recruiter, software often reads your resume
ats.text: Many companies, staffing agencies and job sites sort applications with software called an ATS. It reads the text of your resume and files it in a database. If your resume is misread, or if it lacks the words from the job ad, it may never reach a recruiter

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Question not listed here? Write to us:

ats.a: It's the software many companies, staffing agencies and job sites use to receive and sort applications. It turns your resume into text and lets recruiters search it by keyword. If your resume is misread or lacks the right words, it falls through the cracks

storage.a: Only on your device, in your browser. It never goes through our servers: nobody but you can access it

clear.q: What happens if I clear my browser data?
clear.a: Your resumes are deleted, since they exist nowhere else. Download a backup now and then: you can reopen it anytime, on any device

score.q: Does the score guarantee my resume will be shortlisted?
score.a: No. Every company has its own tools and the final decision is always made by a person. The score helps you reuse the words from the ad and check that your resume reads correctly: you put the odds in your favor

photo.q: Why does the photo disappear in English?
photo.a: In the UK, the US and many English-speaking countries, photos and dates of birth are discouraged to limit hiring discrimination. Some recruiters even reject resumes that include them

free.a: Yes, completely: no subscription, no ads, no watermark on your PDFs. LocalATSCV is an open source project (its code is public) that costs almost nothing to run, since everything happens on your device

templates.q: Do the colorful templates get past screening software?
templates.a: Yes. Every template contains real text, in the right order, with standard headings like “Experience” or “Education”. Shapes, colors and icons are mere decoration that software ignores. Single-column templates remain the safest, and the editor checks your layout live

import.q: Can I reuse my current resume or my LinkedIn profile?
import.a: Yes. Import your resume as a PDF or Word file, or your LinkedIn profile: the content is read on your device and sorted into the editor automatically. All that's left is to proofread it and pick a template

offline.a: Yes. After your first visit, you can edit and download your resumes offline. You can even add LocalATSCV to the home screen of your phone or computer, like an app

method.title: How is this score calculated?
method.intro: There is no official ATS score: every recruiting software (Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, Lever…) has its own, often confidential, rules. This index checks what trips up most of them, with this scale:
method.disclaimer: These criteria come from ATS vendors’ public recommendations and the most common reading errors (text in images, columns, icons, non-standard headings). The score helps you improve your resume: it does not predict selection
